content.comment_body: Can someone offer advice regarding a [product_name]? When programming and simulating in [product_name] software, everything works as expected, but after uploading to the device, the scale and displayed values on the text message screen change unexpectedly. I've set up an analog input and PI, so a counter adjusts the setpoint value, which is shown as SETPOINT on the display. Simulation shows normal behavior, but on actual hardware, the value suddenly jumps to 65870.
Not all details are clear in your screenshot. Please upload your program as a ZIP file.
As requested, I've attached the file. The setup functions well during simulation in [product_name] software, but after uploading to the base unit, the displayed value unexpectedly jumps above 65000.
When I increase the setpoint by one, this is the readout I see on the device—the count increases by one increment starting from the new value.

I swapped counter B002 with B011, and then switched B011 back to B002. After these changes, the counter worked correctly on the actual device. I've attached the revised diagram. I'm unsure why this issue occurs; perhaps only [company_name] can fully explain it.
Thanks [user_name], I'll try your suggestion. Much appreciated.
Wish you a pleasant day as well.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants noted that simulation results in [product_name] software did not match the real-world behavior on the device, with counter values displaying incorrectly on the hardware. Workarounds were attempted, but the community was unable to identify the root cause, speculating that only the manufacturer could provide a conclusive answer.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that programs tested in [product_name] software and run on the corresponding hardware produce consistent and accurate value displays both on PC and the device itself.
